paragraphs: Non-starters with elite per-90 traits add a small squad-depth multiplier to unit ratings (capped at ~5% total; bench cannot dominate outcomes).

sections.title: Expected goals pipeline
paragraphs: The engine splits attack into finishing and chance-creation channels (xA / xG-buildup / xG-chain credit all outfield positions), then applies opponent suppression (back line 54%, mid shield 32%, GK 14%) and midfield battle modifiers.
Raktim raw attack xG: 1.77 finishing + 0.16 creation = 1.93 before suppression. When Moga+Sanmitro defends, suppression factor is 0.843 (DEF 0.51, mid-def 0.32, GK 0.48, transition risk 0.17).
Moga+Sanmitro raw attack xG: 2.20 + 0.24 = 2.45. Raktim suppression when defending: 0.820 (transition risk 0.41).
Midfield battle multipliers: Raktim ×0.993, Moga+Sanmitro ×1.007. Net xG edge: Moga+Sanmitro by 0.51.

paragraphs: Raktim xGA suppression: 0.747 (base without transition penalty: 0.823). Moga+Sanmitro: 0.718 (base 0.811).

Opposition wing threat vs leaky fullbacks: Moga+Sanmitro's wide attack gets a +3.0% xG edge (winger threat 0.69, Raktim transition risk 0.41).
